about: Golden vectors for the channel pool filter. Read by BOTH Nostalgex/NostalgexTests/FilterGoldenTests.swift (AppState.filterItems, tvOS) and scripts/nostalgex-filter-golden-smoke.mjs (scripts/nostalgex-channel-filter.cjs, web tuner and Docker; npm run test:filter-golden). Each case is one item run against the SHIPPED channels.json, its exclusiveRules and channels-memberships.json. `in` lists channel ids (not numbers) the item must reach, `out` the ids it must not. Item fields: title, artist (music videos), episodeTitle, summary, originallyAvailableAt (YYYY-MM-DD, first aired), year, type (movie|episode), librarySource (movie|tv|musicVideo), genres, contentRating (as the server sends it, so GB-15 or FSK-16 for a Jellyfin library outside the US), duration (minutes, default 100), rating, studio, tmdbID (string; only when the case is about a manifest claim), and enrichment ({ keywords, productionCompanies, networks, tmdbGenres }; absent means not enriched), backend (plex|jellyfin|emby, default plex; the server the item came from) and doviProfile (Dolby Vision profile; absent means unknown). When a rule changes, change both engines, then update or add a case here.
